# Wedges for the Scaffold

*Dorrek climbs the highest scaffold himself before any mason goes up, and he wants it wedged tight. Bring him 30 Ridge Bark for wedges.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Dorrek](../npcs/dorrek_kragvar.md) |
| Level | 24 |
| Leads to | [Kragvar Stone](../quests/dorrek_kragvar_stone.md) |

## Objectives

- Bring 30 [Ridge Bark](../items/ridge_bark.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 3,300 EXP
- 480 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- [Highland Salve](../items/highland_salve.md) x5

- +30 standing with [Dorrek](../npcs/dorrek_kragvar.md)
